fields.label: Title
fields.description: The material or material family, for example Two-part epoxy, Part A

fields.label: Item
fields.description: The item code in the ERP, when the profile is for one item. Kept as text; the ERP stays the item master.

fields.label: Factors Help
fields.options: Each factor uses the wording of the standard it comes from (safety data sheet, specification or SOP). The highest factor sets the MPC level; three or more factors at a moderate score or above raise it one more.

fields.label: Hazard (NFPA 704 highest rating, or GHS)
fields.options:
0 - Minimal
1 - Slight / GHS Warning
2 - Moderate
3 - Serious / GHS Danger
4 - Severe
fields.description: Source: NFPA 704; GHS (UN Globally Harmonized System)

fields.label: Occupational exposure band
fields.options:
None
OEB 1
OEB 2
OEB 3
OEB 4
OEB 5
fields.description: Source: OEB 1-5 banding of occupational exposure limits

fields.label: Moisture sensitivity level
fields.options:
Not sensitive
MSL 1
MSL 2
MSL 2a
MSL 3
MSL 4
MSL 5
MSL 5a
MSL 6
fields.description: Source: IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 (floor life after the dry pack is opened)

fields.label: Storage temperature
fields.options:
Ambient
Controlled room temperature
Refrigerated (2-8 C)
Frozen
Cryogenic
fields.description: Source: USP <659> packaging and storage requirements; cold chain practice

fields.label: Atmosphere (dry process)
fields.options:
Ambient
Low humidity
Dry room
Inert gas
Glovebox or isolator
fields.description: Source: Dew point controlled dry rooms; inert gas handling; isolators

fields.label: Cleanroom class at point of use
fields.options:
Not controlled
ISO 8
ISO 7
ISO 6
ISO 5
ISO 4 or cleaner

fields.label: Electrostatic discharge sensitivity
fields.options:
Not sensitive
ESD sensitive
HBM Class 0 (under 250 V)
fields.description: Source: ANSI/ESD S20.20; ANSI/ESDA/JEDEC JS-001 HBM classes

fields.label: Physical form
fields.options:
Discrete rigid
Discrete fragile
Free-flowing bulk or liquid
Cohesive powder, paste or viscous liquid
Compressed gas or cryogenic liquid
fields.description: Source: Bulk solids flowability (Carr index, Hausner ratio, USP <1174>)

fields.label: Shortest Time Limit (hours)
fields.description: The tightest of shelf life, hold time, queue-time limit, floor life, out-time or pot life. 0 means none. Source: ICH Q1A shelf life; hold-time studies; SEMI fab queue-time limits; J-STD-033 floor life

fields.label: Critical Material Attributes
fields.description: Attributes checked at receipt or before use. Source: ICH Q8 critical material attributes

fields.label: Conditioning Steps
fields.description: Steps before the material can be used: thaw, degas, bake, acclimatise, premix

fields.label: Conditioning Minutes
fields.description: Time those steps take. Added to a bin's replenishment lead time in the line-dry forecast.

name: Material Handling Profile
description: How complex a material is to handle and process: its Material Processing Complexity (MPC) level 1 to 5 from standard handling factors
